pages.text: $(l)Novice material conversion$()$(br2)After obtaining the first Source Gem, craft the vessel from Smooth Sourcestone, a Cauldron, ordinary Source Gems, a Source Jar, and a Hopper. It combines fluids, materials, and a small amount of Source to bridge quartz, raw gold, Sourceberries, Archwood fruits, and pottery sherds.

The vessel reduces biome and random-exploration bottlenecks in both Ars Nouveau and Matrix progression. It can also mass-produce Infested Stone for a Novice Vitalic Sourcelink farm. See the Arcane Reaction JEI category for exact ingredients, fluid amounts, Source costs, and times.
